title: A terrible RPG
description: Adds chaotic RPG-style launchers, explosive weapons, and destructive combat to Minecraft.
body:
A Terrible RPG

A Terrible RPG is a Minecraft mod that adds powerful launcher weapons and explosive combat mechanics to the game. Instead of using normal swords and bows, players can fight using dangerous RPG-style launchers capable of destroying terrain, launching mobs, and creating chaotic battles.

This mod is designed for players who enjoy overpowered weapons, explosive gameplay, and fun multiplayer chaos.

Weapons Included
RPG Launcher

A classic explosive launcher built for high-damage combat and large explosions.

Nuke Launcher

An extremely destructive weapon capable of wiping out large areas with massive explosions.

Hunter Launcher

A combat-focused launcher designed for ranged attacks and fighting dangerous enemies.

Mob Launcher

Launch mobs through the air and create chaotic or funny gameplay situations.

Anything Launcher

An unpredictable launcher that can fire unusual projectiles and create random fun moments.

Features
Multiple custom launcher weapons
Explosive combat mechanics
Destructive gameplay
Fun multiplayer chaos
Custom items and textures
Overpowered weapons for survival or creative worlds
Why Download This Mod?

A Terrible RPG completely changes how combat feels in Minecraft. Instead of slow vanilla combat, players can use explosive launchers to:

Fight groups of mobs more aggressively
Cause massive destruction
Create funny multiplayer moments
Experiment with different launcher types
Add arcade-style chaos to survival gameplay
